I can't pull real-time market data, but here's an approximate snapshot of the **top 10 Nasdaq-100 holdings** based on recent data (late 2024 / early 2025). Please verify current figures from a live source like Nasdaq.com, Yahoo Finance, or your brokerage.

| Rank | Company | Ticker | Approx. Weight | Market Cap (USD) | P/E Ratio (TTM) |
|------|---------|--------|---------------|------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Apple | AAPL | ~9.0% | ~$3.5T | ~37 |
| 2 | Microsoft | MSFT | ~7.8% | ~$3.1T | ~34 |
| 3 | NVIDIA | NVDA | ~7.5% | ~$3.3T | ~55 |
| 4 | Amazon | AMZN | ~5.5% | ~$2.3T | ~46 |
| 5 | Meta Platforms | META | ~5.0% | ~$1.5T | ~28 |
| 6 | Broadcom | AVGO | ~4.5% | ~$1.0T | ~165 |
| 7 | Alphabet (Class A) | GOOGL | ~2.6% | ~$2.1T | ~24 |
| 8 | Alphabet (Class C) | GOOG | ~2.5% | (incl. above) | ~24 |
| 9 | Tesla | TSLA | ~3.8% | ~$1.2T | ~110 |
| 10 | Costco | COST | ~2.6% | ~$420B | ~55 |

### Notes
- **Weights** are rebalanced quarterly and capped to prevent over-concentration.
- **P/E ratios** fluctuate frequently; Broadcom's and Tesla's are elevated due to recent earnings dynamics.
- Alphabet appears twice (GOOGL = voting, GOOG = non-voting), often combined when discussing market cap.
- For the **official, current list**, check: [invesco.com/QQQ](https://www.invesco.com/qqq-etf/) (the QQQ ETF tracks the Nasdaq-100).
